assets.description: Modular male/female body, face, hair, beard and hand sprite atlas
assets.prompt: Production modular character atlas for SHATTERDEEP dark fantasy mobile pixel-art RPG. 1536x1024 PNG, exactly six columns and four rows of 256x256 cells. Fully transparent background, NO backdrop NO ground NO drop shadows NO text NO grid lines NO glow. Generous 16-pixel margin per cell. Detailed crisp premium pixel-art, consistent three-quarter FRONT view turned slightly toward the viewer's right. Everything adult, fully nonsexual. Every body uses same neutral standing pose, hands relaxed near outer hips, elbows slightly bent, feet pointing slightly right, left screen foot slightly forward. All parts aligned for modular paper doll assembly. Row 1 left to right: 0 headless adult MALE body neck to feet, average build, plain fitted light gray sleeveless linen tunic, belt, charcoal trousers and simple dark shoes, bare arms; 1 headless adult FEMALE body neck to feet, average build, same practical sleeveless gray tunic, belt charcoal trousers and shoes, bare arms; 2 isolated bald male head and short neck, balanced oval face, medium warm skin; 3 isolated bald male head short neck, angular jaw and sharp brows, same skin; 4 isolated bald male head short neck, rugged mature face scar on cheek, same skin; 5 isolated bald male head short neck, soft round face, same skin. Row 2: 6 isolated bald female head short neck balanced oval; 7 isolated bald female head short neck angular sharp cheekbones; 8 isolated bald female head short neck rugged face with cheek scar; 9 isolated bald female head short neck soft round face; all same warm medium skin as men and same 3/4 direction. 10 isolated SHORT TOUSLED silver-gray hairstyle wig with transparent space where face is, no face head or mannequin; 11 isolated CHIN-LENGTH BOB silver-gray hairstyle wig with transparent face opening, no skin. Row 3: 12 isolated LONG LOOSE silver-gray hairstyle wig no skin; 13 isolated HIGH PONYTAIL silver-gray hairstyle wig no skin; 14 isolated TWIN BRAIDS silver-gray hairstyle wig no skin; 15 isolated BUZZ CUT silver-gray hair cap wig no skin; 16 isolated short STUBBLE beard mask grayscale dark with transparent mouth; 17 isolated neat SHORT BEARD grayscale, no face skin. Row 4: 18 isolated FULL BEARD grayscale no face; 19 isolated MUSTACHE grayscale no face; 20 adult male right hand closed around an imaginary vertical weapon grip, no weapon, warm medium skin; 21 adult male left closed hand same; 22 adult female right closed hand same; 23 adult female left closed hand same. Faces and hair must all face the same slightly right-facing 3/4 direction and be easy to overlay. Hair grayscale for runtime recoloring. Headless bodies must contain no helmet no head no hair no weapons no armor. Lighting from upper left. Crops must never touch cell borders or cross into neighboring cells. Transparent alpha around every isolated sprite.
